provenance.dynamical: Gaia-era Oort-limit determinations (Read 2014 review; Widmark, Bovy and successors cluster at 0.08-0.10)

verdict: The Solar neighbourhood's mass ledger balances. Counted luminous matter (0.0897 Msun/pc^3) plus the halo dark matter density (0.0100) accounts for the dynamical total (0.1000) to within 0.0138 Msun/pc^3. Any cold, non-radiating, engineered mass component is therefore bounded at 0.0280 Msun/pc^3 at 2 sigma, i.e. below 1.17e+05 Msun within 100 pc (70% of the local stellar mass). This bound holds regardless of temperature, spectral slope, beaming geometry or energy source, because it is a statement about gravity alone. It does not and cannot produce a detection: the residual is dominated by the local dark matter density, which is real and is not attributed to engineering.
